title: Downgrading My Bougie Lifestyle
transcript: Hi I'm Anna, and I am downgrading my bougie life. Over the years, I've built myself quite a nice life. Premium groceries, expensive coffees, all the subscriptions. But recently I realised something. The lifestyle's great, but the job I'm doing to pay for it is taking up all of my time and headspace. So I'm running a little experiment. I'm downgrading all the little expensive habits and I'm gonna see what's actually worth the money. And here's the catch. The goal isn't really to spend less money, it's just to need less money so that I can have a more flexible life in the future. So I'm taking a career break and I've got one year to downgrade my bougie lifestyle and prove to myself that I'm not trapped in a corporate 9 to 5 forever. Let's see what's actually worth it and what isn't.
